hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a custom 1:1 ETH↔phiEth swap curve using beforeSwapReturnsDelta, taking input from the PoolManager, depositing/withdrawing via the phiEth contract, and settling output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Blocks direct liquidity additions and restricts pool initialization to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fees.
